_comment: Copy to config.json next to worker.py (service installs use /etc/addon-sync.json). `preset` picks a feed definition from feeds/ and supplies thread_url, the addon folders and the release naming; anything set here overrides the preset. Empty strings fall back to folders under the state directory.

downloader._comment: method: watchdir (drop .magnet files for your torrent client), direct (http links only), or command (run this with {magnet} replaced). Empty keeps the preset's choice, else watchdir.
